books.title: Sacred Reparenting: A Spiritual and Intuitive Guide to Healing from Toxic Parents
books.author: Lisa Campion
books.description: Her fifth book, published by Reveal Press (New Harbinger), offers a spiritual route through the after-effects of a difficult upbringing. Meditations, journaling, ancestral practices and intuitive exercises help readers care for the inner child, set boundaries and build a relationship with what she calls the Divine Parent.

courses.title: Sacred Reparenting: Healing from Toxic Parents (Kripalu)
courses.description: A weekend programme at Kripalu built on her book Sacred Reparenting. Through meditation, light hands-on energy work, writing exercises and work in small groups, participants tend the wounds of a hard childhood, with care taken around trauma.
